name: tracker-docker-relay
goal: Prove one real Tracker push and pull with host-held synthetic signing through the unchanged offline Docker task adapter, with denied requests, confinement, and task-owned cleanup on MB2.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Pinned #163 and #157. Real guest journal push and pull over private attached stdio, exact route and request admission, host-only synthetic HMAC, no guest network, and verified task-owned teardown on MB2 with one worker.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added an explicit Docker Desktop proof using #163 adapter stdio, a scratch-only unsigned spoke seam, and original #157 HMAC and hub logic over two disposable journals.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: MB2 guest verified one push and pull, matching rows and cursors 1/2, exactly two host HMAC requests, 14 rejected requests, an oversized frame rejected before signing, and both Docker cleanup paths. The first failing isolation probe counted unaddressed kernel tunnel interfaces; the corrected check confirms loopback is the only addressed interface alongside Docker's network-none inspection.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
